WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSserved
  FROM schools AS s
  WHERE s.NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.DOC = '54'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 12
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM satscores AS sat
      WHERE sat.cds = s.CDSCode
        AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
    )
),
spans AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-') - 1) = 'P' THEN -2
      WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-') - 1) = 'TK' THEN -1
      WHEN substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-') - 1) = 'K' THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(substr(GSserved, 1, instr(GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
    END AS start_grade
  FROM eligible
),
earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_grade) AS start_grade
  FROM spans
)
SELECT School AS school_name, GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM spans
WHERE start_grade = (SELECT start_grade FROM earliest)
ORDER BY School;

WITH active_charters AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, FundingType
    FROM schools
    WHERE Charter = 1
      AND StatusType = 'Active'
      AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
frpm_by_school AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        SUM("Enrollment (K-12)") AS enrollment_k12,
        AVG("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") AS frpm_pct
    FROM frpm
    WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
    GROUP BY CDSCode
),
sat_by_school AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS combined_sat
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT
    a.FundingType,
    COUNT(*) AS active_charter_schools,
    SUM(f.enrollment_k12) AS total_enrollment_k12_2014_2015,
    ROUND(AVG(f.frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_percent,
    ROUND(AVG(s.combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM active_charters AS a
LEFT JOIN frpm_by_school AS f ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN sat_by_school AS s ON s.cds = a.CDSCode
GROUP BY a.FundingType
ORDER BY a.FundingType;

WITH funding_types AS (
  SELECT 'Directly Funded' AS funding_type, 1 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Locally Funded', 2
),
county_charters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         f.CDSCode,
         f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
    AND s.DOCType LIKE '%County%'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly Funded', 'Locally Funded')
),
latest_frpm AS (
  SELECT f.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY f.CDSCode
           ORDER BY f."Academic Year" DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM frpm AS f
)
SELECT ft.funding_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.CDSCode) AS currently_operating_schools,
       COALESCE(SUM(l."Enrollment (K-12)"), 0) AS total_k12_enrollment,
       COALESCE(SUM(l."FRPM Count (K-12)"), 0) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM funding_types AS ft
LEFT JOIN county_charters AS c
  ON c.funding_type = ft.funding_type
LEFT JOIN latest_frpm AS l
  ON l.CDSCode = c.CDSCode
 AND l.rn = 1
GROUP BY ft.funding_type, ft.sort_order
ORDER BY ft.sort_order;

),
eligible AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f."County Name" AS county_name,

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        s.CDSCode,
        s.School AS school_name,
        s.GSserved,
        s.Charter,
        f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] * 1.0
            / NULLIF(f.[Enrollment (K-12)], 0) AS free_meal_rate,
        sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
      AND (s.GSserved LIKE '%12%' OR s.GSserved LIKE '%K-12%')
      AND f.[Enrollment (K-12)] > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(free_meal_rate) OVER () AS highest_rate
    FROM eligible
)
SELECT
    school_name,
    printf('%.4f', free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE Charter
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    GSserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM ranked
WHERE free_meal_rate = highest_rate

WITH dated AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    pa.overall_rating,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pa.player_api_id
      ORDER BY pa.date DESC, pa.id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes AS pa
  WHERE date(pa.date) <= date('2013-07-12')
    AND lower(trim(pa.defensive_work_rate)) IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
asof AS (
  SELECT player_api_id, overall_rating
  FROM dated
  WHERE rn = 1
),
donovan AS (
  SELECT a.overall_rating
  FROM asof AS a
  JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * ((SELECT overall_rating FROM donovan) - AVG(overall_rating))
  / AVG(overall_rating),
  2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM asof;

         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

         ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  WHERE pa.date <= '2013-07-12 23:59:59'
),
population AS (
  SELECT r.player_api_id, r.overall_rating
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE r.rn = 1
    AND LOWER(r.defensive_work_rate) IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_rating,
         MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'

  JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = population.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (landon_rating - avg_rating) / avg_rating, 2)
       AS percentage_higher
FROM stats;

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) AS month
  FROM account
),
districts_opened AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN first_month AS f
    ON strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = f.month
),
populations AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A4 AS inhabitants
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN districts_opened AS o
    ON o.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT district_id, district_name, inhabitants
FROM populations
WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MAX(inhabitants) FROM populations)
ORDER BY district_id;

WITH borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opening_date
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district AS branch
        ON branch.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE branch.A2 = 'Prachatice'
),
loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
counterparty_counts AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT "account") AS outside_counterparty_count
    FROM trans
    WHERE bank IS NOT NULL
      AND "account" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    ba.account_id,
    ba.opening_date,
    lt.total_amount_borrowed,
    COALESCE(cc.outside_counterparty_count, 0) AS outside_counterparty_count,
    home.A2 AS home_district,
    home.A8 AS home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home.A8 DESC) AS population_rank
FROM borrowing_accounts AS ba
JOIN loan_totals AS lt
    ON lt.account_id = ba.account_id
JOIN disp AS owner
    ON owner.account_id = ba.account_id
   AND owner.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = owner.client_id
JOIN district AS home
    ON home.district_id = c.district_id
LEFT JOIN counterparty_counts AS cc
    ON cc.account_id = ba.account_id
ORDER BY
    home.A8 DESC,
    ba.account_id ASC;

WITH account_avg AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
gold_holders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cl.gender, owner_disp.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.disp_id = c.disp_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
    JOIN account_avg AS aa
      ON aa.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
     AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           gh.gender,
           d.district_id,
           d.A2 AS district_name,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
           d.A11 AS salary,
           d.A10 AS urban_ratio
    FROM gold_holders AS gh
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = gh.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
),
summary AS (
    SELECT gender,
           COUNT(*) AS district_count,
           MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants,
           ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM qualifying_districts
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT CASE s.gender
           WHEN 'F' THEN 'women'
           WHEN 'M' THEN 'men'
           ELSE s.gender
       END AS gender,
       s.district_count,
       q.district_name,
       q.inhabitants AS most_inhabited_district_inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM summary AS s
JOIN qualifying_districts AS q

           ELSE 'paid off'
         END AS standing
  FROM loan

  GROUP BY account_id
),
activity AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,

  FROM trans

    AND date < '1998-01-01'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
profile AS (
  SELECT b.account_id,
         b.opened_date,

           - CAST(strftime('%Y', b.birth_date) AS INTEGER)

               WHEN strftime('%m-%d', b.birth_date) > '12-31' THEN 1
               ELSE 0
             END AS age_years,
         COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
         COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
           ELSE ls.standing
         END AS loan_standing,
         COALESCE(act.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
         COALESCE(act.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
         COALESCE(act.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
         COALESCE(act.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance
  FROM base_accounts AS b
  LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc
    ON cc.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_stats AS ls
    ON ls.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN activity AS act
    ON act.account_id = b.account_id

ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WHERE r.year = 2017

WITH q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.nationality,
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q2 <> ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT nationality, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY seconds) AS time_rank
  FROM q2_times
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM ranked
WHERE time_rank = 2
ORDER BY nationality;

  FROM qualifying q

WITH editions AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.date
  FROM races AS r
  WHERE r.year >= 1990
    AND r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
),
driver_best_laps AS (
  SELECT e.raceId, e.date, lt.driverId, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS best_ms
  FROM editions AS e
  JOIN lapTimes AS lt ON lt.raceId = e.raceId
  GROUP BY e.raceId, e.date, lt.driverId
),
drivers_over_90_seconds AS (
  SELECT b.raceId, d.forename, d.surname, b.best_ms
  FROM driver_best_laps AS b
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = b.driverId
  WHERE b.best_ms > 90000
)
SELECT e.date,
       q.forename,
       q.surname,
       CASE
         WHEN q.best_ms IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE printf(
           '%d:%02d.%03d',
           q.best_ms / 60000,
           (q.best_ms % 60000) / 1000,
           q.best_ms % 1000
         )
       END AS fastest_lap
FROM editions AS e
LEFT JOIN drivers_over_90_seconds AS q ON q.raceId = e.raceId
ORDER BY e.date, q.surname, q.forename;

treatment.sql:
WITH french_gp_editions AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.date
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.year >= 1990
      AND r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
), driver_best_laps AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
    FROM lapTimes l
    JOIN french_gp_editions e ON e.raceId = l.raceId
    WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.raceId, l.driverId
), qualifying_rows AS (
    SELECT e.date, d.forename, d.surname, b.fastest_ms
    FROM french_gp_editions e
    LEFT JOIN driver_best_laps b
      ON b.raceId = e.raceId AND b.fastest_ms < 90000
    LEFT JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = b.driverId
)
SELECT date, forename, surname,
       CASE WHEN fastest_ms IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE printf('%d:%02d.%03d', fastest_ms / 60000,
                        (fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000, fastest_ms % 1000)
       END AS fastest_lap
FROM qualifying_rows
ORDER BY date ASC, surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC, forename COLLATE NOCASE ASC

WITH italian_q3 AS (
    SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3
    FROM qualifying AS q
    JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
    WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
      AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
), fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(
        CAST(SUBSTR(q3, 1, INSTR(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
        + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
        + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, INSTR(q3, ':') + 4, 3) AS INTEGER)
    ) AS fastest_ms
    FROM italian_q3
)
SELECT DISTINCT iq.forename, iq.surname, iq.q3 AS fastest_q3_lap_time
FROM italian_q3 AS iq
CROSS JOIN fastest AS f
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(iq.q3, 1, INSTR(iq.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
    + CAST(SUBSTR(iq.q3, INSTR(iq.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
    + CAST(SUBSTR(iq.q3, INSTR(iq.q3, ':') + 4, 3) AS INTEGER) = f.fastest_ms

baseline.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverId,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    q.q3,
    r.name AS race_name,
    r.year AS race_year
  FROM drivers AS d
  JOIN qualifying AS q ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) > 1980
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
    AND q.q3 <> '\N'
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(q3, ':') > 0
        THEN CAST(substr(q3, 1, instr(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      ELSE 0
    END
    + CAST(
        CASE
          WHEN instr(q3, ':') > 0 THEN substr(q3, instr(q3, ':') + 1)
          ELSE q3
        END AS REAL
      ) * 1000 AS q3_ms
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT
  forename || ' ' || surname AS driver_full_name,
  race_name,
  race_year,
  q3 AS q3_time
FROM parsed
WHERE q3_ms = (SELECT MIN(q3_ms) FROM parsed)
ORDER BY driver_full_name, race_year, race_name;

treatment.sql:
WITH british AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'British'
      AND CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) > 1980
), timed AS (
    SELECT b.forename || ' ' || b.surname AS full_name,
           r.name AS race_name,
           r.year AS race_year,
           q.q3 AS q3_time,
           CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
             + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, instr(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1), '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
             + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS time_ms
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN british b ON b.driverId = q.driverId
    JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
), fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(time_ms) AS time_ms FROM timed
)
SELECT full_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM timed
WHERE time_ms = (SELECT time_ms FROM fastest)
ORDER BY full_name, race_year, race_name

), q3_times AS (
  SELECT d.driverRef, q.q3,
         MIN(CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +

WITH september_races AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2016
    AND strftime('%m', date) = '09'
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(p.milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
  FROM pitStops AS p
  JOIN september_races AS sr ON sr.raceId = p.raceId
  WHERE p.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,

JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId

WITH winning_drivers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.driverId,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        d.dob,
        d.nationality
    FROM drivers AS d
    JOIN results AS res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
),
oldest_winner AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM winning_drivers
    ORDER BY dob ASC, forename COLLATE NOCASE ASC, surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
    SELECT r.name, r.date
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    JOIN oldest_winner AS ow ON ow.driverId = res.driverId
    WHERE res.position = 1
      AND r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
    ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS full_name,
    ow.nationality,
    fw.name AS first_race_won,
    fw.date AS first_win_date,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM results AS res
        JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
        WHERE res.driverId = ow.driverId
          AND r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
    ) AS races_started
FROM oldest_winner AS ow
CROSS JOIN first_win AS fw;

WITH target_race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, 1, INSTR(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER),
        CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, INSTR(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL),

  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN target_race AS tr ON tr.raceId = q.raceId
  LEFT JOIN results AS r
    ON r.raceId = q.raceId AND r.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM ranked AS x
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = x.driverId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = x.constructorId
WHERE x.q2_rank = 2;

    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q2 <> ''
)

FROM session_times
WHERE time_rank = 2;

WITH chinese_races AS (
  SELECT raceId, year, time AS scheduled_time
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
    AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
),
earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(time(scheduled_time)) AS start_time
  FROM chinese_races
  WHERE scheduled_time IS NOT NULL
),
selected AS (
  SELECT cr.*
  FROM chinese_races AS cr
  JOIN earliest AS e ON time(cr.scheduled_time) = e.start_time
  ORDER BY cr.year DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
classified AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.positionOrder, r.milliseconds, r.time AS result_time,
         d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver
  FROM results AS r
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE r.positionOrder IN (1, 2)
)
SELECT s.year AS season_year,
       s.scheduled_time AS scheduled_local_start_time,
       winner.driver AS winner,
       runner.driver AS runner_up,
       CASE
         WHEN runner.milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND winner.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
           THEN runner.milliseconds - winner.milliseconds
         ELSE runner.result_time
       END AS runner_up_gap
FROM selected AS s
JOIN classified AS winner
  ON winner.raceId = s.raceId AND winner.positionOrder = 1
JOIN classified AS runner
  ON runner.raceId = s.raceId AND runner.positionOrder = 2;

WITH timed_races AS (
  SELECT c.circuitRef,
         CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL AND length(r.time) >= 8
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_seconds,
         MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_seconds
  FROM timed_races
),
selected AS (
  SELECT 'earliest' AS endpoint, t.circuitRef, e.earliest_seconds AS start_seconds
  FROM timed_races AS t
  CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
  WHERE t.start_seconds = e.earliest_seconds

  UNION

  SELECT 'latest', t.circuitRef, e.latest_seconds
  FROM timed_races AS t
  CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
  WHERE t.start_seconds = e.latest_seconds
)
SELECT endpoint, circuitRef, start_seconds,
       e.latest_seconds - e.earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM selected
CROSS JOIN extremes AS e
ORDER BY CASE endpoint WHEN 'earliest' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, circuitRef;

WITH timed_races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.circuitRef,
         time(r.time) AS local_start_time
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND time(r.time) IS NOT NULL
), extrema AS (
  SELECT MIN(local_start_time) AS earliest_time,
         MAX(local_start_time) AS latest_time
  FROM timed_races
), answer_rows AS (
  SELECT 'earliest' AS endpoint,
         tr.circuitRef,
         e.earliest_time AS start_time,
         (strftime('%s', e.latest_time) - strftime('%s', e.earliest_time)) AS gap_seconds
  FROM timed_races AS tr CROSS JOIN extrema AS e
  WHERE tr.local_start_time = e.earliest_time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'latest' AS endpoint,
         tr.circuitRef,
         e.latest_time AS start_time,
         (strftime('%s', e.latest_time) - strftime('%s', e.earliest_time)) AS gap_seconds
  FROM timed_races AS tr CROSS JOIN extrema AS e
  WHERE tr.local_start_time = e.latest_time
)
SELECT endpoint, circuitRef, start_time, gap_seconds
FROM answer_rows
ORDER BY CASE endpoint WHEN 'earliest' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, circuitRef

WITH event_counts AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_date,
    COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
  FROM event AS e
  LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.event_date
),
fall_average AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 1) AS avg_attendance
  FROM event_counts
  WHERE event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND event_date < '2019-12-01'
),
soccer AS (
  SELECT attendee_count
  FROM event_counts
  WHERE event_name = "Women's Soccer"
)
SELECT
  soccer.attendee_count AS womens_soccer_attendees,
  fall_average.avg_attendance AS fall_2019_average_attendees,
  CASE
    WHEN soccer.attendee_count > fall_average.avg_attendance THEN 'more'
    WHEN soccer.attendee_count < fall_average.avg_attendance THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
FROM soccer
CROSS JOIN fall_average;

WITH college_departments AS (
  SELECT department, GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT department, major_name
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
    ORDER BY department, major_name
  )
  GROUP BY department
),
member_major_counts AS (
  SELECT link_to_major AS major_name, COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM member
  WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(link_to_major) <> ''
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
department_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    m.department,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN mm.member_count > 0 THEN m.major_name END,
      ', '
    ) AS majors_held,
    AVG(COALESCE(mm.member_count, 0)) AS avg_members_per_major
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT department, major_name
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
  ) AS m
  LEFT JOIN member_major_counts AS mm
    ON mm.major_name = m.major_name
  GROUP BY m.department
)
SELECT
  cd.department AS department_name,
  cd.majors_offered,
  COALESCE(dm.majors_held, '') AS majors_held_by_members,
  ROUND(dm.avg_members_per_major, 2) AS average_members_per_major_offered
FROM college_departments AS cd
JOIN department_metrics AS dm
  ON dm.department = cd.department
ORDER BY cd.department;

  FROM major
  WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
department_totals AS (
  SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS majors_offered
  FROM college_majors
  GROUP BY department
),
member_major_counts AS (
  SELECT
    cm.department,
    cm.major_id,
    cm.major_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS members_holding
  FROM college_majors cm
  LEFT JOIN member m ON m.link_to_major = cm.major_id
  GROUP BY cm.department, cm.major_id, cm.major_name
)
SELECT
  dt.department,
  GROUP_CONCAT(mm.major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered,
  GROUP_CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN mm.members_holding > 0 THEN mm.major_name END,
    ', '
  ) AS majors_held_by_members,
  ROUND(SUM(mm.members_holding) * 1.0 / dt.majors_offered, 2)
    AS average_members_per_major
FROM department_totals dt
JOIN member_major_counts mm ON mm.department = dt.department
GROUP BY dt.department, dt.majors_offered
ORDER BY dt.department
LIMIT 1000;

WITH qualifying_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_budget
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
),
line_balances AS (
    SELECT
        q.link_to_budget,
        b.amount - COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS amount_left
    FROM qualifying_lines AS q
    JOIN budget AS b
        ON b.budget_id = q.link_to_budget
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e
        ON e.link_to_budget = q.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY q.link_to_budget, b.budget_id, b.amount
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.amount_left), 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS qualifying_expense
    ON qualifying_expense.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN line_balances AS lb
    ON lb.link_to_budget = qualifying_expense.link_to_budget
WHERE qualifying_expense.cost > 50
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC;

WITH over_fifty_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
),
budget_line_remaining AS (
    SELECT
        e.link_to_budget,
        MAX(b.amount) - SUM(e.cost) AS remaining_amount
    FROM expense AS e
    JOIN budget AS b
      ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY e.link_to_budget
),
member_budget_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget
    FROM expense
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(blr.remaining_amount), 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM over_fifty_members AS q
JOIN member AS m
  ON m.member_id = q.link_to_member
JOIN member_budget_lines AS mbl
  ON mbl.link_to_member = q.link_to_member
JOIN budget_line_remaining AS blr
  ON blr.link_to_budget = mbl.link_to_budget
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC;

WITH bond_stats AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
), grouped AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         m.label,
         CASE
           WHEN COALESCE(bs.bond_count, 0) = 0
             OR bs.single_bond_count = bs.bond_count THEN 'every bond is single'
           ELSE 'all other molecules'
         END AS saturation_group
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond_stats AS bs ON bs.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT saturation_group,
       SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
       - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM grouped
GROUP BY saturation_group
ORDER BY CASE saturation_group
           WHEN 'every bond is single' THEN 1
           ELSE 2

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
        SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(element) = 'CL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        b.molecule_id,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(a1.element) = 'C' OR UPPER(a2.element) = 'C' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(b.bond_type) IN ('DOUBLE', 'TRIPLE', '=', '#', '2', '3') THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond AS b
    JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
        COALESCE(ac.number_of_atoms, 0) AS number_of_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
        COALESCE(ac.carbon_atoms, 0) AS carbon_atoms,
        COALESCE(ac.chlorine_atoms, 0) AS chlorine_atoms,
        COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
        COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM molecule AS m
    LEFT JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE COALESCE(ac.carbon_atoms, 0) >= 1
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank,
    molecule_id,
    carcinogenicity_label,
    number_of_atoms,
    number_of_bonds,
    carbon_atoms,
    chlorine_atoms,
    carbon_touching_bonds,
    multiple_bonds
FROM qualifying
ORDER BY rank;

),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN a1.element <= a2.element
        THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element
      ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element
    END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1
    ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
   AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a2
    ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
   AND a2.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  bc.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
  bc.bond_count,
  COALESCE(pc.element_pair_count, 0) AS element_pair_count,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_counts bc
LEFT JOIN pair_counts pc ON pc.bond_type = bc.bond_type
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY bc.bond_count DESC, bc.bond_type ASC;
